push_headlines: Asia mixed: the KOSPI +3.30%, the Nikkei 225 +0.85%, the Hang Seng -0.70%.
Brent near $110.40 and WTI around $98 to $100 as the Iran war keeps oil elevated.
UK inflation at 3.5% weighs on the FTSE 100 open; Europe mixed to flat early.
on_notice: Oil near $110.40 Brent, after a Tuesday swing of more than $6, with attacks on Gulf shipping and no sign of diplomacy to end the Iran war.
Rate-hike worries at the Bank of England after UK inflation climbed to 3.5%.
Whether renewed oil strength revives inflation fears and hits growth stocks such as chipmakers.

asia.headline: Asia mixed: the KOSPI +3.30%, the Nikkei 225 +0.85%.
asia.detail: The KOSPI closed at 5,735.66 with chip and tech stocks leading, and the Nikkei 225 closed at 64,621.24 while the Topix +0.86% ended at 4,043.73. The Taiex +1.30%. Gains followed a Wall Street rally on strong earnings.

sources.name: US News / AP, Asian shares mixed

china.headline: Greater China lower: the Hang Seng -0.70%, the Shanghai Composite -0.60%.
china.detail: The Hang Seng closed at 23,707.11 and the Shanghai Composite at 3,713.36.

sources.name: US News / AP, Asian shares mixed

europe.headline: Europe mixed to flat early; UK inflation at 3.5% weighs on London.
europe.detail: The FTSE 100 opened 26 points lower at 10,706 as UK inflation climbed to 3.5%, raising concern about further Bank of England rate hikes. Early trading showed the STOXX 600 roughly flat, and no same-day close was found, so these are early-session readings.

latam.headline: No usable same-day Latin America report found tonight.
latam.detail: Searches returned only undated or older sessions, so no index levels are quoted here.

mideast.headline: Brent near $110.40 as the Iran war keeps oil elevated.
mideast.detail: Brent jumped early Wednesday to $110.40 after nearing $112 on Tuesday, close to its highest since the war began in late February. WTI was around $98 to $100. Attacks on Gulf shipping continue with no sign of diplomatic progress.

sources.name: US News / AP, Asian shares mixed
